in_sanskrit.name: Parvraj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wanderer, Traveler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Parvraj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Parvraj is a Sanskrit word that means 'wanderer' or 'traveler'. This name is derived from the root words 'par' meaning 'beyond' and 'vraj' meaning 'to wander'. Parvraj signifies someone who is always on the move, seeking new experiences and adventures.
